ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation along the trailing edges and distal tips; interior regions of both lobes feature high-intensity white background with dense, irregular low-intensity black mottling and linear streaks. A distinctive small circular black ring is visible on the inner-middle section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with approximately a 40-45 degree angle of convergence; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous boundary with high-frequency variations; multiple sharp peaks and valleys are visible, particularly prominent along the medial and lateral sections of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, characterized by significant irregular interruptions along the boundary line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-contrast, textured clusters of barnacle colonization (white and tan pixels) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing both lobes; visible as white-on-black and black-on-white high-contrast streaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonies on the distal tips and several deep, non-uniform indentations/notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggestive of tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique small annular (ring-shaped) pigment mark on the lower-middle quadrant of the right lobe.
